reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down Ferrari. Ferrari was founded in 1929 as a race team by Italian driver, Enzo Ferrari. Today, the car company is one of the most recognizable brands in the world, in large part because of its history in Formula 1.

key_points.text: Ferrari was founded in 1929 as a race team by Italian driver, Enzo Ferrari.
Today, the car company is one of the most recognizable brands in the world, in large part because of its history in Formula 1.
To break down Ferrari, I’m joined by Brian Lum, an Investment Manager at Baillie Gifford.
